acquisitions_currency_consistent.name: acquisitions_currency_consistent
acquisitions_currency_consistent.value: ("acquisitions"."price_amount" IS NULL AND "acquisitions"."currency_code" IS NULL) OR ("acquisitions"."price_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "acquisitions"."currency_code" IS NOT NULL AND "acquisitions"."currency_code" = upper("acquisitions"."currency_code"))

copies_lifecycle_consistent.name: copies_lifecycle_consistent
copies_lifecycle_consistent.value:
(
        "copies"."lifecycle_code" = 'ACTIVE'
        AND "copies"."current_collection_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "copies"."exit_reason_code" IS NULL
        AND "copies"."exited_at" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "copies"."lifecycle_code" = 'EXITED'
        AND "copies"."current_collection_id" IS NULL
        AND "copies"."exit_reason_code" IS NOT NULL
        AND "copies"."exited_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

games_duration_range_valid.name: games_duration_range_valid
games_duration_range_valid.value: "games"."max_duration_minutes" IS NULL OR ("games"."max_duration_minutes" >= 0 AND ("games"."min_duration_minutes" IS NULL OR "games"."max_duration_minutes" >= "games"."min_duration_minutes"))

games_age_range_valid.name: games_age_range_valid
games_age_range_valid.value: "games"."max_age" IS NULL OR ("games"."max_age" >= 0 AND ("games"."min_age" IS NULL OR "games"."max_age" >= "games"."min_age"))

games_scope_consistent.name: games_scope_consistent
games_scope_consistent.value:
(
        "games"."visibility_code" = 'PRIVATE'
        AND "games"."classification_code" = 'PRIVATE'
        AND "games"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "games"."moderation_status_code" IN ('DRAFT', 'ARCHIVED')
      ) OR (
        "games"."visibility_code" = 'PUBLIC'
        AND "games"."classification_code" IN ('OFFICIAL', 'COMMUNITY')
        AND "games"."moderation_status_code" IN ('APPROVED', 'ARCHIVED')
      )
